four_layer_diagnosis.claim_alignment: untested -- EXT-002 asserts a property of transformer LLMs (subject llm.hallucination); what the run manipulates is the ARC-013 residue rider. Neither claim was tested under conditions where it could express itself: the DV's agent-side degree of freedom was zero by construction on the pinned board and only 2/8 seeds trained. The recorded non_contributory self-route is correct and STANDS.
four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: present -- the closest mechanism (hippocampal/striatal eligibility trace + one-trial aversive/avoidance learning) predicts that a persistent error trace changes WHETHER the animal re-approaches the erred location/action (passive avoidance, fewer revisits), not the harm probability conditional on re-approaching, which in a deterministic world is fixed by the world. The 983 lineage's DV (decline in P(harm | revisit)) is the second quantity. This is a measurement-level divergence from the biological signature, not a translation failure of the residue mechanism.
four_layer_diagnosis.prerequisites: present -- residue field populated (32/32 centres, coverage 1.0) in A0 and empty in A1; INV-006/INV-004/ARC-004 are implemented; the E3 residue readout (Phi_R) is the canonical path.
four_layer_diagnosis.implementation: partial -- the ablation is clean and wired into the canonical selection path (E3 compute_residue_cost -> residue_field.evaluate_trajectory at half weight, rho_residue 0.5); it changed executed actions in 5/8 seeds (divergence 0.12-0.57) and changed NO executed action in 3/8 (0.00/0.00/0.03) with a populated field and a positive candidate-score range (whether the argmin winner moved is unmeasured; candidate first-actions can collapse to one class). Separately, the per-seed survival split is best explained by the E3 policy latching a single action class per seed (stay-like -> death in ~11 steps/episode; constant-move -> survival), i.e. the monostrategy / actor-adequacy locus. That is inferred from harm-rate profile matching against control policies plus a 25-step probe, not from a training-phase repertoire readout, which was never recorded.
four_layer_diagnosis.environment: adequate-but-unforgiving, not the lever -- pinned 6x6 board with 4 hazards and a start inside the proximity field on every seed: a constant mover survives all 8 boards and a random walker dies on all 8, so the boards do not discriminate and no board screen could reproduce the 6/8 casualty split. Pinning does make every (cell,action) outcome world-determined for keys whose target is not a consumable resource (seed 11's 0.14/0.17 heterogeneity came through resource consumption), which is the DV-construct problem in the measurement row.
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: misleading -- (i) the load-bearing DV (decline in repeat_rate = P(harm | revisit of an erred key)) is construct-invalid on a pinned board (1.000 both halves, both arms, 6/8 seeds); (ii) key registration only on fresh E3 ticks hides ~90% of harm events and produced seed 31's 0-key P4 failure; (iii) the avoidance quantity (revisit rate of erred keys) was recorded as raw early/late counts but not scored; (iv) P4 aggregates by MIN over pooled cells so one degenerate seed vetoes; (v) dv_headroom fired on n=1 finite seed. RECORDING GAP: no per-arm training-phase executed-action-class histogram (only the 25-step probe), so the latching reading cannot be confirmed from the manifest.
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: partially coupled -- residue -> E3 argmin -> action changed behaviour in 5/8 seeds and not at all in 3/8; the coupling is seed-dependent and its determinant is unrecorded.
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: likely insufficient -- 8 seeds drawn, 2 pooled at exactly the MIN_POOLED_SEEDS floor, one of them with no registered erred keys. A floor of 2 admits a degenerate pair.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-09-06 governance-20260906-1604, inline failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-983a_2026-09-06, Fable cross-model red-team CONTESTED on routing, contests folded in] V3-EXQ-983a (residue-frozen ablation REDESIGN, FAIL, 18.1h, ree-worker-3, supersedes V3-EXQ-983) self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue and is ratified non_contributory on TEST-DESIGN grounds; no verdict on the EXT-002 rider. THREE DEFECTS, all in the driver/design, none a substrate build: (1) DV construct: pinning the board per seed (the F1 fix for 983's per-episode hazard lottery) makes P(harm | revisit of the same (cell,action)) world-pinned for every key whose target is not a consumable resource -- repeat_rate 1.000 in both halves of both arms in 6/8 seeds, revisit_outcome_heterogeneity 0.00 in every pooled cell vs the 0.10 floor (only seed 11, excluded on the steps floor, showed any: 0.14/0.17 via resource consumption) -- so decline_gap's achievable range was 0.0 (measured over seed 456's two arms; seed 31 contributed NaN) against the 0.04 bar: the first production firing of the dv_headroom refusal path, which worked. What a persistent error trace changes in a deterministic world is WHETHER the agent revisits an erred key, not the harm probability given a revisit. (2) Key registration: first_harm_at is written only on fresh E3 ticks (1 tick in 10; the other 9 are held commitments), so a harm on a held tick never registers -- seed 31 logged 330 harm events and 0 erred keys, and P4 (min early-half revisits over pooled cells) read 0 vs 4.5 because of it; ~90% of harm events are invisible to the DV in every seed. (3) Seed population: the training-completion gate excluded 6/8 seeds (steps_realized_frac 0.056-0.475 vs 0.60; harm_rate_train 0.13-0.99 vs 0.35; 5/8 died to agent_health<=0 within 6-12% of budget, seed 11 at 47%), leaving exactly the MIN_POOLED_SEEDS=2 floor. Red-team control probes on the same 8 pinned boards: a constant-move policy survives 200/200 on ALL 8, a random walker dies on ALL 8 (13-16 steps), 'stay' dies on ALL 8 (every start sits inside the proximity field). So no board screen can produce the 6/8 split; the split is WHICH single action class the E3 argmin latches per seed (casualties match the stay profile, ~11 steps/episode at harm 0.8-1.0; survivor 31's harm_rate 0.0150 equals the constant-action profile on its board, with byte-identical A0/A1 streams). That is the monostrategy / actor-adequacy locus (zworld_actor_adequacy_locus, V3-EXQ-1002; MECH-269/MECH-341/ARC-065 line) -- a read-across, not adjudicated here: the only action-repertoire readout is a 25-step probe (executed_action_classes 1.0-2.0), the training-phase histogram was never recorded. Residual carried, not erased: the ablation changed executed actions in 5/8 seeds (same-seed action-stream divergence 0.12-0.57) and changed NO executed action in 3/8 (0.00/0.00/0.03; seeds 23/31/42) despite a populated 32-centre field and a positive candidate-score range; a post-hoc unregistered read of the avoidance quantity (late-half revisits to erred keys, A0 vs A1) is mixed across seeds (A1 fewer in 456: 92 vs 102; A1 more in 7/17/123; equal in 23), n=2 trained -- exploratory, not evidence. Re-derive brake: literal count 2 (983 + 983a) under the blanket-category counter, RELEASED as a producer decision: both readings are instrument/test-design defects owing no substrate build (action none). REFUSED nonetheless: any 983-lineage letter keeping the repeat-rate DV or the fresh-tick key registration. ROUTE: /queue-experiment, NEW EXQ number, a cheap DIAGNOSTIC spike first (record per-seed training-phase action-class histogram + survival under the canonical E3 policy on these pinned boards, hours not 18h) that decides whether the rider test is gated on the actor line, then, if the repertoire exists, the evidence re-pose with a hold-aware revisit-AVOIDANCE DV (held-tick harm attributed to the governing fresh-decision key), a per-seed gate on action-stream divergence > 0 and on training-phase action-class diversity, MIN_POOLED_SEEDS 3. Status stays candidate; epistemic_category stays standard (test-design diagnosis, no ceiling asserted); no substrate hold placed on EXT-002.

learning_extracted: Two correct repairs were jointly fatal: pinning the layout (right, for 'the same error') plus an unchanged conditional-harm DV guarantee repeat_rate = 1.0 for every non-resource key. A DV conditional on an agent-chosen event needs its conditional outcome certified world-free BEFORE the run; P7 did it after 18h.

Key registration gated on fresh E3 ticks (1 in 10) silently discards ~90% of harm events and can zero a seed's erred-key set outright (seed 31: 330 harms, 0 keys). A held-tick harm must be attributed to the governing fresh-decision key.

No board screen can fix this bed: a constant mover survives all 8 pinned boards and a random walker dies on all 8. The 6/8 casualty split is which single action class the E3 argmin latches per seed -- the monostrategy / actor-adequacy locus, recurring here with the canonical select_action path. A post-training completion gate can only exclude; it turned 8 seeds into a 2-seed floor with one degenerate member.

The residue signal's reach into executed behaviour is all-or-nothing per seed (0.00/0.00/0.03 vs 0.12-0.57) with a populated field and a positive candidate-score range. Recorded, not gated, unexplained; the successor should gate per seed on divergence > 0.

Recording gap (Experimental Recording Standard): the training-phase per-arm executed-action-class histogram existed at run time and was never written; only a 25-step probe is. Without it the latching reading is profile-matching, not measurement.

The dv_headroom refusal path fired correctly in production for the first time (achievable 0.0 vs 0.04, n=1 finite seed): validation evidence for dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class, and a reminder that it is a post-hoc net.

Infra: the three 'lockstep' brake counters are not in lockstep -- the SKILL.md recipe honours recommended_epistemic_category_per_claim and validate_queue.py::_autopsy_counts_toward_brake does not; an artifact with a per-claim non-ceiling stamp counts under one and not the other. Reported for a fix; this artifact avoids the shape.
Post-hoc, unregistered, explicitly not evidence: the avoidance quantity (late-half revisits, A0 vs A1) is mixed across seeds with n=2 trained.
targets.routing_note: queue-experiment, NEW EXQ number (not 983b), two stages. STAGE 1 (diagnostic, hours): on the same 8 pinned boards under the canonical E3 policy, record per-seed training-phase executed-action-class histogram, survival curve, and harm attribution with held-tick harms keyed to the governing fresh decision; pre-registered readout: fraction of seeds whose training repertoire is a single action class. If latched in most seeds -> the rider test is gated on the actor-adequacy / monostrategy line (existing work: zworld_actor_adequacy_locus portfolio chipped 2026-09-05; MECH-269 / MECH-341 / ARC-065), report to governance, do not run stage 2. STAGE 2 (evidence, only if the repertoire exists): residue-frozen ablation with a hold-aware revisit-AVOIDANCE DV (fresh-decision revisits to erred keys per unit exposure, early vs late, A0 minus A1), P7-style certification of DV freedom under a control policy BEFORE training, per-seed gate on action-stream divergence > 0 and on action-class diversity, MIN_POOLED_SEEDS 3, seeds drawn until the floor is met. Governance chips both after ratification (CLAUDE.md 2026-07-30). Also for governance: record validation_record_983a on dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class; chip an infra fix reconciling the per-claim-category branch across the three brake counters.

zworld_actor_adequacy_locus (registry) / V3-EXQ-1002 / MECH-269 / MECH-341 / ARC-065: the per-seed survival split matches single-action-class latching under the canonical E3 select_action (control-policy profile match + 25-step probe).
